shortDescription: UPSC NDA II Exam Schedule 2026. Verify the latest notice on upsc.gov.in before you apply, download or treat a result as final.
content:
Union Public Service Commission has issued an exam-city, schedule or admit-card related update for UPSC NDA II Exam Schedule 2026.

Download the hall ticket or city intimation only from the official portal. Carry a printed copy and photo ID to the venue.

How to download

  1. Open upsc.gov.in
  2. Use the Admit Card / Exam City login
  3. Enter registration number and password or date of birth
  4. Print the PDF and check shift, city and reporting time

editorNotes: Independent listing for candidates. NaukriMitra is not a government website. Always open the official recruiting-body URL before paying a fee or relying on a result.
importantInstructions: Do not share login OTPs. Download PDFs only from the official domain. Dates and vacancy counts on aggregator sites can lag behind the notice.

faqs.question: Where can I verify UPSC NDA II Exam Schedule 2026?
faqs.answer: Use the official website: https://upsc.gov.in. This page only points you there.

faqs.question: Are the dates on this page final?
faqs.answer: No. Treat every date as a prompt to re-check the latest PDF or login dashboard on the official portal.
